title: Origin story: Yamata no Orochi
description: Yamata no Orochi was the eight-headed, eight-tailed serpent that terrorized the land of Izumo, demanding a maiden each year. When Susanoo found the weeping Kushinada as the last sacrifice, he had her family brew eight vats of sake, intoxicated each head, and slew the beast — finding the sword Kusanagi in its tail.
